# zillizcloud_service_account_api_key (Resource)

Manages an API key belonging to a Service Account. The key inherits all account permissions. The secret is returned only on creation and stored in Terraform state; protect your state backend. Import cannot recover the secret. The owning account must be active when creating or editing keys. Changing expire_days replaces the key; use create_before_destroy when rotating credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zillizcloud_service_account" "ingestion" {
  name = "ingestion-service"
  project_assignments = {
    "proj-a" = ["r-project-writer"]
  }
}

resource "zillizcloud_service_account_api_key" "ingestion" {
  service_account_id = zillizcloud_service_account.ingestion.id
  name               = "ingestion-key"
  description        = "Primary credential"
  expire_days        = 90

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

output "ingestion_secret" {
  value     = zillizcloud_service_account_api_key.ingestion.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expire_days` (Number) Validity in 24-hour days from creation, from 1 to 730. Changes replace the key. Imported keys with a non-integer-day or unlimited lifetime require replacement.
- `name` (String) Key name, 1–128 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace.
- `service_account_id` (String) Owning Service Account ID. Changes replace the key.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, up to 255 characters. An empty string clears it.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) Creation time in UTC ISO 8601 format.
- `created_by` (String) Creator email or API key ID.
- `creator_name` (String) Creator display name.
- `expire_time` (String) Expiration time in UTC ISO 8601 format; null for a legacy key without expiration.
- `id` (String) API key ID.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret returned only when creating the key. Unavailable for imported keys.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import zillizcloud_service_account_api_key.ingestion sa-example/key-example
```
